data.eligible_state_rule: Score every causal mover information state for which the opponent has 0 < K < N unknown cards. Preserve all scored states; do not select, top up, or discard states after seeing a label or prediction.

allowed: observer current hand and observer-known own deck draws
chronological public opponent actions strictly before the scored state
public expeditions and ordered discard piles
round, cumulative scores, within-round ply, deck count, and actor relative to observer
forbidden: source-policy probabilities, logits, values, search worlds, or RNG
source actor identity as a model feature
information_boundary.label: exact unknown K-card subset in the opponent hand, consulted only after the scrubbed view and causal trace have been constructed
information_boundary.origin_proof: The native information-boundary tests reject complete referee states, prove exact-K support, prove action traces contain public move fields only, and reproduce the locked exact-17 current-view suit-orbit hash. Evaluation preserves paired candidate and control sums from the same generated source match.

source_actor.policy_contract: The scaled head-only control must be byte-identical to champion.bin outside wbel/bbel, so it generates the same policy distribution. The candidate never drives a trajectory.

data.capped_prefix_semantics: A source trajectory may stop when the engine ply cap fires. Every already observed causal prefix remains valid accuracy evidence; capped_rounds is retained, no later round is fabricated from an incomplete cumulative score, and candidate/control pairing remains exact.
data.split_unit: source trajectory cluster; every generated round, seat, and causal prefix for a source_match_id remains in one split
data.state_count_contract: Source-match counts and ordered source_match_id ranges are exact. State counts are data-dependent and must be positive for every retained source trajectory and identical across each candidate/control pair; no fabricated fixed states-per-match count is permitted.
data.training_branch_contract: The 262,144-match base head is fitted in four ordered 65,536-match resumable chunks with one root and disjoint contiguous match ranges. The residual and matched-control branches then start from the identical frozen base head and consume the identical 65,536 source trajectories, match IDs, public prefixes, exclusions, labels, order, and source-manifest digest under root 202706100101. Their augmentation objectives deliberately differ: the residual is suit-invariant and consumes the frozen 20-way base posterior, reconstructed through float log-weights with marginals numerically equivalent within the locked 2e-6 tolerance, while the control trains on one deterministic scheduled suit-group member per state. Their permitted parameter ranges and optimizers also differ.

bootstrap.method: paired source-match cluster bootstrap with deterministic SplitMix64 resampling, marginal percentile bounds, and single-step simultaneous max-standardized-error one-sided bounds

simultaneous_familywise.zero_standard_error_policy: report null simultaneous LCB, mark inferentially ineligible, and fail the affected replacement bundle

brier_gate.quantity: ordered comparator per-card Brier minus proposed replacement per-card Brier on all eligible TEST states

history_gate.quantity: ordered comparator joint NLL minus proposed replacement joint NLL on states after at least one observed opponent action

mandatory_reports: joint NLL per state and uncertain card for all eligible states
joint NLL per state and uncertain card after at least one opponent action
tie-correct top-K recall for both scopes
source-trajectory, scored-state, uncertain-card, positive-card, completed-round, and capped-round counts

primary_gate.comparator: the three direct ordered comparisons are history versus the matched-budget head-only control, history versus the maintained champion head at alpha 1.15, and matched-budget head-only control versus that incumbent; every pair uses identical TEST source matches and states
primary_gate.quantity: ordered comparator joint NLL minus proposed replacement joint NLL on all eligible TEST states

evaluation.verdict_scope: Predictive accuracy gain of the fixed causal action-history branch over an equally trained state-only branch on trajectories generated by the frozen self-play actor. It is not evidence about human-opponent calibration and does not attribute gain to any single action feature.

terminal_artifact_selection.comparison_bundle: For each ordered replacement comparison, require the frozen all-state joint-NLL, post-opponent-action joint-NLL, and all-state per-card-Brier point/simultaneous-one-sided-nominal-99%-LCB gates directly. One max-standardized-error critical value controls the nine-component selection family asymptotically; exact finite-sample coverage is not claimed and marginal percentile bounds are report-only. A zero original cluster SE is inferentially ineligible and fails its bundle. Never infer a pair by transitivity.
rule: retain history only if history passes directly against both matched_head_control and incumbent_head
otherwise retain matched_head_control only if it passes directly against incumbent_head

structural_gates.artifact_provenance: Every model, checkpoint, resumable control state, executable, plan, execution binding, workflow, training summary, and raw shard is SHA-256 bound; row fingerprints must agree with the sealed identity, which contains one shared_train_source_manifest_sha256 proved equal by the residual and matched-control branches.
structural_gates.exact_k: Every evaluated support contains exactly N uncertain legal cards, every label contains exactly K of them, all marginals are finite in [0,1], and their sum equals K within 2e-4.
structural_gates.head_only_control: Both the 262,144-match base head and the matched-budget continuation differ from champion.bin only in wbel/bbel, retain exact three-copy wager tying, and bind the active exact17 manifest plus every ordered training range in their checkpoint proofs.
structural_gates.hidden_information: Complete referee states fail the inference boundary; opponent hidden hand, hidden deck, future actions, and truth cannot enter trace or feature construction.
structural_gates.opening_uniform: Before the first observed opponent action the history candidate equals the uniform exact-card-count prior within the locked 2e-6 marginal tolerance.
structural_gates.probe_firewall: The canonical 17-orbit manifest is SHA-256 bound. Every history-training and evaluation state is scrubbed, hashed, and rejected before its truth label is read; rows bind manifest SHA/count, exclusion count, and an enabled structural flag.
structural_gates.suit_equivariance: Exact suit relabelling leaves corresponding history logits bitwise equal.
structural_gates.wager_tying: All three physical wager copies receive bitwise equal history logits.

evidence.raw_predictions_required: Every TEST source match preserves paired history-candidate, matched-budget head-only control, maintained incumbent champion head at alpha 1.15, diagnostic 262,144-match base head, and uniform-exact-K raw metric sums for all eligible and post-opponent-action scopes.
evidence.strict_serialization: sealed identities and verdicts use canonical sorted-key ASCII JSON; native rows use one deterministic fixed-order finite ASCII JSON object per LF-terminated line; every artifact has a SHA-256 sidecar and no producer may clobber an existing output
evidence.training_source_identity: Residual and matched-control training summaries must independently emit the same pre-truth public-source SHA-256; the workflow verifies equality and seals it once as shared_train_source_manifest_sha256.

execution_protocol.compile_once: Preflight builds and tests the native runtime once and seals a source-free transport verified by every consumer.
execution_protocol.launch: one non-forced attempt-1 push adding exactly the previously absent execution addendum as a unique direct child of this definition

pre_efficacy_throughput_guard.purpose: Fail before any production root is touched unless source-free history and head-control smokes demonstrate that every fixed 65,536-match training or evaluation job fits the hosted-job budget with reserve.

python_dependencies.install: Download the one hash-pinned wheel in preflight; every reducer installs it from the sealed source-free transport with --no-index --no-deps.

incumbent_head.artifact: the maintained data/champion.bin belief head scored without fitting on TEST

freeze.rule: Architecture, alpha, optimizer, learning rate, regularization, and every candidate byte are frozen directly after TRAIN. There is no SELECT split, fitted calibrator, or pre-TEST efficacy look. Exactly one immutable LCBHM1 artifact reaches untouched TEST.

non_goals: changing or promoting the maintained actor
changing the live policy-cost v7 run or any of its files, seeds, artifacts, or gates
using exact-17 artifacts as training, calibration, selection, or test inputs
claiming human-opponent calibration beyond the frozen source-policy distribution

probe_firewall.proof: The source-free runtime includes only the bound 17-hash manifest, never reviewed states or comments. Native tests reproduce the canonical hash probe; training and evaluation check the scrubbed current-view suit orbit before truth, and raw rows bind manifest SHA/count plus exclusion counts.
